video_title: LeBron’s Arrival in Philly, Jaylen Brown’s Role and a SLEEK Joel Embiid! | The Hoop Collective

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and Jaylen Brown working out together
quotes.excerpt: LeBron, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and Jaylen Brown together on the court for a personal workout

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I got to the facility this morning and I was talking to one of the coaches. I said, you have a good sweat, you're getting on the treadmill or whatever? He said, no, we just did a workout on the court. I'm thinking the young guys, right? No, LeBron, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and Jaylen Brown together on the court for a personal workout ahead of training camp starting on Tuesday. To me, that was notable.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Not just ahead of training camp, ahead of media day.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's physical conditioning and weight loss ahead of the season
quotes.excerpt: He's dropped significant pounds. I don't know if his weight on the roster has changed.
quotes.quote: Joel Embiid looks pretty sleek. As sleek as he's been since very early in his career at least, which, listen, if they're going to play fast, he's going to have to be slimmed down to keep up. I don't know if the weights on the roster don't necessarily mean anything. I don't know if his weight on the roster has changed, but his weight in reality is, like, he's dropped significant pounds.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's improved physical conditioning compared to last season
quotes.excerpt: Luka might be in better shape this year than he was last year.
quotes.quote: I want to report to you that Luka might be in better shape this year than he was last year.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's weight and fitness progression since his rookie season
quotes.excerpt: I do think Luka's as lean as he's been since his rookie year.
quotes.quote: I do think Luka's as lean as he's been since his rookie year. Luka, I think, was listed 218 his rookie year, probably was legitimately like 230-ish, and he looks like he's in about that range now.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's impact on team dynamics and the 'grand bargain'
quotes.excerpt: I've long described it as the grand bargain that you make with LeBron.
quotes.quote: I've long described it as the grand bargain that you make with LeBron. There's going to be a lot of extra attention, some of it is naturally going to be negative, whether that's fair or not. There's going to be passive-aggressive stuff, you're going to have to deal with social media stuff occasionally. There's going to be times where he wants the roster changed, not that he's ever been a guy to pound the door, but there's times when he doesn't like the coach and all these things, but the output on the floor is always been worth it.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse's challenge in managing the 76ers' roster
quotes.excerpt: This is going to be largely on Nick Nurse to figure out how to make this work.
quotes.quote: I think one of the guys who's got a really hard job this year is Nick Nurse. The fact that these, you know, that Embiid and Maxey and Jaylen, and you know, LeBron said with Steve Nash that he had worked out pre before training camp with him a handful of times, Jaylen Brown. They're obviously really trying to make this work, but ultimately this is going to be largely on Nick Nurse to figure out how to make this work. Nick is a guy who has had a lot of success in sort of making different styles, different players, different schemes work, but this is going to be a challenge.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The challenge of Joel Embiid and LeBron James playing back-to-back games
quotes.excerpt: It seems like it will be unlikely to play back-to-backs.
quotes.quote: It seems like it will be unlikely to play back-to-backs. We'll see where LeBron stands. Obviously, he claims that he feels great, his body feels great, but will they really push the pedal to the metal and try to have him play back-to-backs? If both those guys don't play, you're going to have to be working on two vastly different looking lineups all the time.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The lack of continuity in the 76ers' roster due to injuries and rotations
quotes.excerpt: They basically had three different versions of the 76ers.
quotes.quote: They basically had three different versions of the 76ers. The fully healthy version, which was the least seen, the Embiid's in, Paul George's out, and then the Paul George's in, Embiid's out. And that's why there was never any kind of continuity that they were really able to develop with the 76ers. And that's the thing, it's not just that you want Embiid healthy because obviously you want that guy on the floor, but for them to work through these things and develop any kind of chemistry or continuity, you can't get a 40-game season out of Embiid.
